etymology.hint: flesh

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺼ (flesh/body) — 脸 relates to the face, a part of the body
佥 (qiān) gives a loose sound connection to 脸's reading liǎn

makemeahanzi.definition: heavy, weighty; to double, to repeat

etymology.hint: A burden carried for a thousand 千 miles 里

characterDeckComponents.note: 千 (thousand) — 重 pictures a heavy burden carried a great distance.
里 (a unit of distance, like a mile) — carrying something a thousand 里 emphasizes how heavy and significant a burden it is, giving 重 its meaning 'heavy' or 'important.'

etymology.hint: heart

characterDeckComponents.note: 心 (heart) — 恩 relates to feelings of gratitude and kindness.
因 (yīn) gives the sound — an exact match with 恩.

meanings: (past tense marker used before verb or clause)

etymology.hint: A rice cooker on heat 日, building up steam 丷 and letting it off

characterDeckComponents.note: Originally pictured a container for steaming food: 日 at the bottom represents the heat or cooking vessel, and 丷 at the top shows the steam rising and escaping — giving 曾 its meaning 'once, already.'

etymology.hint: boar

characterDeckComponents.note: 豕 (pig/boar) — appears as part of 象's original full-body pictograph of an elephant, reusing a four-legged-animal shape; 象 itself depicts an elephant's trunk and ears above the body.

meanings: costume (of an actor in a play)

makemeahanzi.definition: dress, clothes, attire; to wear, to install

etymology.hint: clothes

characterDeckComponents.note: 衣 (clothing) — 装 relates to clothes, dress, and attire
壮 (zhuàng) gives the sound — 装 is pronounced zhuāng, a close match

makemeahanzi.definition: law, rule, statute; method, way; French

etymology.hint: The course 去 followed by a stream 氵

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water/stream) — water naturally follows a fixed course, an image linked to the idea of 'law' or 'method.'
去 (to go/a course) — the path a stream follows suggested a regulated, consistent way of doing things, hence 'law, method.'

meanings: the last month of a season

etymology.hint: The time for planting seeds 子 of grain 禾

characterDeckComponents.note: 禾 (a grain stalk) — a crop ready for harvest.
子 here representing a seed, together giving 季 its meaning 'season,' the time for planting and harvest.

makemeahanzi.definition: cause, mission, orders; envoy, messenger, ambassador

etymology.hint: A person 亻 working for the government 吏

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 使 involves a person carrying out a task.
吏 (a government official) — 使 originally referred to an official sent to carry out orders, giving rise to the meaning 'to make someone do something' or 'to use.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to move, to convey; to turn, to revolve, to circle; to forward mail

etymology.hint: cart

characterDeckComponents.note: 车 (cart) — relates to 转's meaning 'to turn, change direction,' like a wheel turning.
专 (zhuān) gives a sound hint — 转 is pronounced zhuǎn, sharing the same base sound with a different tone.

etymology.hint: Two  parallel lines; compare 一 (one) and 三 (three)

characterDeckComponents.note: 二 is simply two horizontal strokes stacked together — the most direct way to picture the number two, following the same pattern as 一 (one) and 三 (three).

etymology.hint: bow

characterDeckComponents.note: 弓 (bow) — a strong bow that took great force to draw gave 强 its meaning 'strong, powerful.'
虫 was a different phonetic element historically; its pronunciation has shifted so far from qiáng over time that the sound link is no longer obvious.

etymology.hint: ox

characterDeckComponents.note: 牛 (ox) — 特 originally referred to a male ox singled out for sacrifice, a special animal set apart from the herd.
寺 (sì) gives a hint of the sound — 特 is pronounced tè, a connection that has drifted over time.

meanings: substance used for a specific purpose

makemeahanzi.definition: drugs, medicine; the leaf of the Dahurian angelica plant

etymology.hint: plant

characterDeckComponents.note: 艹 (grass/plant) — many traditional medicines were made from plants and herbs
约 (yuē) gives a sound related to 药's reading yào, from an older, closer pronunciation link

etymology.hint: A chalice 皿 filled with blood 丿

characterDeckComponents.note: 皿 (a vessel) — a chalice or bowl
丿 — a single drop of blood inside the vessel

makemeahanzi.definition: to injure, to harm; wound, injury; to fall ill
to study, to learn; to read, to pronounce

etymology.hint: To show off 卖 one's literacy 讠

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — the words being spoken aloud from a text
卖 (to sell/show off) — showing off what one has learned by reading

makemeahanzi.definition: to glance at, to look at, to see

etymology.hint: eye

characterDeckComponents.note: 目 (eye) shows 瞧 relates to looking or seeing.
焦 (jiāo) gives a sound distantly related to qiáo, having drifted apart in the initial consonant over time.

etymology.hint: Half of a tree trunk; compare 爿

characterDeckComponents.note: A pictograph of half of a split tree trunk, shown in cross-section (compare 爿, the other half) — the source of 片's meaning 'a thin slice, piece.'

etymology.hint: A man's face blacked by soot from a fire 灬

characterDeckComponents.note: 黑 pictures a face or window blackened by soot rising from a fire 灬 below — giving 黑 its meaning 'black, dark.'

meanings: the main part of a structure or body

etymology.hint: A pregnant woman

characterDeckComponents.note: 身 depicts a person's torso, originally showing a pregnant woman's body — later broadened to mean 'the body' in general.

makemeahanzi.definition: to make; to write, to compose; to act, to perform

etymology.hint: A person 亻 making something for the first time 乍; 乍 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) plus 乍 (suddenly/for the first time) — together suggesting a person making or doing something for the first time.

makemeahanzi.definition: sex, nature, character; suffix converting a verb to an adjective

etymology.hint: heart

characterDeckComponents.note: 忄 (heart/mind) — 性 relates to inner nature or character.
生 (shēng) gives a hint of the sound — 性 is pronounced xìng, a related sound though the initial has shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: to exceed, to surpass, to transcend

etymology.hint: run

characterDeckComponents.note: 走 (run/walk) — relates to 越's meaning 'to exceed, cross over,' running past a boundary.
戉 (yuè) gives the sound — 越 is also pronounced yuè, an exact match.

etymology.hint: Something tasty 甘 to the tongue 舌

characterDeckComponents.note: 舌 (tongue) — taste is sensed on the tongue.
甘 (sweet, tasty) contributes to the character's form, naming the flavor itself.

makemeahanzi.definition: to fear, to be afraid of; apprehensive

etymology.hint: heart

characterDeckComponents.note: 忄 (heart) — 怕 relates to a feeling of fear in one's heart
白 (bái) gives a loose sound connection to 怕's reading pà

makemeahanzi.definition: mark, sign; to note, to record

etymology.hint: A private 己 note 讠; 己 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech/writing) — the act of putting words down.
己 (oneself, private) — writing down one's own private notes or memories, giving 记 its meaning 'to record, remember.'

meanings: dialectal equivalent of 什麼|什么[shen2 me5]

etymology.hint: mouth

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 啥 is a spoken question word, produced with the mouth.
舍 (shè) gives a sound close to shà, sharing the same initial.

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 聲; see that character for the etymology

characterDeckComponents.note: 声 (simplified from 聲) refers to sound; the traditional form combined several elements related to hearing and music, simplified here into a more compact shape.

meanings: classifier for sections of a TV series etc: episode

makemeahanzi.definition: to gather, to collect; set, collection

etymology.hint: Birds 隹 flocking on a tree 木

characterDeckComponents.note: 隹 (a bird) — one of a flock.
木 (a tree) — birds flocking together on a tree, the image of gathering that gave 集 its meaning 'to gather, collect; a collection.'

etymology.hint: building

characterDeckComponents.note: 广 (shelter/building) — 店 names a building used for business.
占 (zhàn) gives a sound distantly related to diàn, having drifted apart over time.

etymology.hint: wine

characterDeckComponents.note: Wine — the original sense described the strong taste of wine.
Gives the sound gào, related to kù but drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to guard, to watch; alarm, alert

etymology.hint: speech

characterDeckComponents.note: 言 (speech) — 警 relates to speaking out a warning or alarm
敬 (jìng) gives a sound close to 警's reading jǐng, sharing a similar historical pronunciation

etymology.hint: ship

characterDeckComponents.note: 舟 (boat) — 船 is a vessel that travels on water, directly tied to its meaning 'ship, boat'

meanings: classifier for pairs or sets of things

makemeahanzi.definition: give, deliver, pay, hand over; entrust

etymology.hint: To hand 寸 something over to someone 亻

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (a person) — someone receiving something
寸 (a hand) — a hand handing something over

etymology.hint: walk

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (to walk) — 遍 relates to covering ground everywhere, or going through something from start to end.
扁 (biǎn) gives a sound close to biàn, sharing the same rhyme and differing mainly in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: walk, stroll, pace, march; to make progress

etymology.hint: Modern form of 歨; putting one foot 止 in front of the other

characterDeckComponents.note: 止 (a footprint), shown twice — one foot placed in front of the other, the source of 步's meaning 'step, pace.'

meanings: (suffix) person with a certain vice or addiction etc

etymology.hint: A ghost with a scary face

characterDeckComponents.note: The 田-shaped top pictures a large, strange head.
儿-shaped legs below trace a crouching, spindly body, together giving 鬼 the shape of a ghostly figure.

etymology.hint: A man 亻 being hit 夂 on the head 囟

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 傻 describes a state of mind a person is in.
囟 (the top of the head), together with a striking motion below, pictures someone being hit on the head — the odd image behind 傻's meaning 'foolish.'

makemeahanzi.definition: criminal; to violate, to commit a crime

etymology.hint: dog

characterDeckComponents.note: 犭 (dog) — 犯 originally related to a dog attacking, later extended to any act of violation
㔾 (jié) gives a sound distantly related to 犯's reading fàn, having drifted apart over time

makemeahanzi.definition: to throw, to hurl, to cast away

etymology.hint: hand

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — throwing is an action done with the hand.
乃 (nǎi) gives a sound distantly related to rēng, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: to wish (sb bon voyage, happy birthday etc)
person who invokes the spirits during sacrificial ceremonies

makemeahanzi.definition: to pray; to wish well; surname

etymology.hint: A person 兄 praying before an altar 礻

characterDeckComponents.note: 礻 (altar, spirit) on the left sets a religious scene.
兄 (a person, shown here kneeling or speaking) on the right shows someone praying, giving 祝 its meaning 'to wish, to pray for blessings.'

meanings: Tibetan unit of land area, about 6 ares

makemeahanzi.definition: to subdue, to restrain, to overcome; used in transliterations

etymology.hint: A weapon 十 used to subdue a beast 兄

characterDeckComponents.note: 十 (here representing a weapon or armor) — 克 pictures overcoming an opponent.
兄 (a person, here representing a formidable figure) — overcoming a strong opponent gave 克 its meaning 'to overcome' or 'to be able to.'

etymology.hint: An open mouth

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 is a simple picture of an open mouth.

etymology.hint: ear

characterDeckComponents.note: 耳 (ear) — the original meaning of 耶 is unrelated to its modern use, which is mainly phonetic.
阝 (a place-name element) gives a sound distantly related to yé, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: (bound form) Japan (abbr. for 日本[Ri4 ben3])

etymology.hint: The sun

characterDeckComponents.note: 日 depicts the sun as a circle with a dot or short stroke inside — a simplified picture of the sun's disc, later squared off in the standard script.

etymology.hint: A lost 厶 jade 玉

characterDeckComponents.note: 玉 (jade, shown without its dot) represents something valuable.
厶 beneath suggests something slipping away privately, giving 丢 its meaning 'to lose, to throw away.'

meanings: to assign a name, title etc

makemeahanzi.definition: life; destiny, fate, luck; an order, instruction

etymology.hint: An order 令 given by mouth 口

characterDeckComponents.note: 令 (an order, command) — 命 pictures issuing a command.
口 (mouth) — a command given aloud gave 命 its meaning 'order' or 'decree,' and by extension, 'fate' or 'life.'

makemeahanzi.definition: out, outside, external; foreign; in addition

etymology.hint: Night-time 夕 divinations 卜; the supernatural, the foreign

characterDeckComponents.note: 夕 (evening, night) — divination was traditionally done in the evening.
卜 (to divine, reading cracks in bone or shell) — combined with 夕 (evening), an evening divination was for unusual or 'outside' matters, giving 外 its meaning of 'outside' or 'foreign.'
